# Method comparison (generated by scripts/method_bars.py)

Same chains, same 24-stem M3 Hamiltonian, scored against the FR3D structures. Hit = fraction of chains where the readout is the exact optimum of the model.

## 100 shots (25 chains)

| method | sensitivity | PPV | MCC | hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Exact (CP-SAT) | 0.739 | 0.700 | 0.711 | 1.00 |
| SA 5 sweeps | 0.742 | 0.707 | 0.716 | 0.97 |
| SKQD constrained drive | 0.691 | 0.687 | 0.679 | 0.60 |
| VQE best sample | 0.577 | 0.685 | 0.619 | 0.16 |
| SKQD transverse drive | 0.601 | 0.662 | 0.618 | 0.31 |
| SA 1 sweep | 0.589 | 0.646 | 0.606 | 0.26 |
| VQE baseline readout | 0.198 | 0.356 | 0.255 | 0.04 |
| SQD LR-QAOA sampler | 0.012 | 0.015 | 0.013 | 0.01 |
| Random bitstrings | 0.005 | 0.005 | 0.004 | 0.00 |
